songs.loopNote: Play the bars above again and again
songs.dropHere: Drop the file to open it

band.label: Who you hear
band.note: Set the balance while you play. Yames remembers it for this song.
band.leftOut: {{tracks}} is in this file, but Yames has nobody to play it.
band.leftOut_other: {{tracks}} are in this file, but Yames has nobody to play them.
band.droppedNotes: {{count}} note in this file is for an instrument the band does not have.
band.droppedNotes_other: {{count}} notes in this file are for instruments the band does not have.

engine.cannotPlay: Yames cannot play this song through the band right now. The click still keeps time.
engine.busy: Something else is using the sound, so the song stopped. Press play again when you are ready.

empty.title: Bring in a song you already have
empty.body: Open a Guitar Pro or MusicXML file and Yames shows you the tab, keeps time, and follows where you are. Drop the file anywhere on this screen, or choose one.
empty.private: The file stays on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.

tab.failed: Yames read this file but cannot draw it. The bars and the timing still work.

warn.tempoFlattened: The tempo slides in {{count}} bar. Yames steps it at the bar line instead.
warn.tempoFlattened_other: The tempo slides in {{count}} bars. Yames steps it at the bar line instead.
warn.barOverfilled: Bar {{bar}} holds more than its time signature allows. It is played as written.

library.dueTitle: You asked to come back to this one
library.starterTitle: Came with Yames. Delete it whenever you like.

review.title: How that went
review.nothingToSay: Nothing stood out in that one. Play it again and the coach will have more to go on.
review.chordsHonesty: I can't check the notes inside chords yet, only their timing.
review.notSaved: Yames could not write this one down, so it won't be there to compare against next time.
review.tooShort: That was too short to judge. Play at least eight notes of the passage and the coach will have something to say about it.

tab.nothing: Nothing was played in these bars.

mark.accentQuiet: Written with an accent, but it did not come out louder

amount.tripletEighth: about a third of a beat

consistentMiss.1: Same spot every time — you lost {{bars}} on {{affected}} of {{goes}}.
consistentMiss.2: It comes apart in {{bars}}: gone {{affected}} times out of {{passes}}.
consistentMiss.3: The rest holds up. It's {{bars}} that keeps going missing, on {{affected}} of {{goes}}.

rushing.1: You're ahead of the click through {{bars}} — {{amount}} early, all the way through.
rushing.2: There's a rush in {{bars}}: {{amount}} early on average.
rushing.3: Sit back into {{bars}}. You're landing {{amount}} early in there.

dragging.1: You're behind the click through {{bars}} — {{amount}} late.
dragging.2: There's a drag in {{bars}}: the notes land {{amount}} after the beat.
dragging.3: Lean into {{bars}} a little. It's sitting {{amount}} late.

afterShift.1: Every time your hand moves in {{bars}}, the next note arrives {{amount}} {{when}}.
afterShift.2: The position change in {{bars}} is costing you {{amount}} {{when}} on the note after it.
afterShift.3: Land the shift in {{bars}} and the rest follows — right now the note after it is {{amount}} {{when}}.

fallsApart.1: You start {{bars}} clean and lose it by the end.
fallsApart.2: It's the back half of {{bars}} that goes — the front of it is fine.
fallsApart.3: Stamina, not notes: {{bars}} gets scrappier the further in you get.

extras.1: There are notes in {{bars}} nobody asked for — {{extras}} of them.
extras.2: You're adding {{extras}} in {{bars}}. Let the rests be rests.
extras.3: Something extra is creeping into {{bars}}: {{extras}} that aren't written.

uneven.1: It's not early or late in {{bars}} — it's uneven. The notes land all over.
uneven.2: Your timing wanders through {{bars}} rather than leaning one way.
uneven.3: Steady before fast: nothing in {{bars}} is consistent yet, in either direction.

beatPositionBias.1: Beat {{beat}} of the bar is the one that gets away — {{amount}} {{when}}, every bar.
beatPositionBias.2: You lean on beat {{beat}}: {{amount}} {{when}} whenever it comes round.
beatPositionBias.3: It's beat {{beat}} that's out, bar after bar — {{amount}} {{when}}.

subdivisionWeak.1: Note {{position}} of every {{outOf}} is the one you keep dropping.
subdivisionWeak.2: In each group of {{outOf}}, it's note {{position}} that goes missing.
subdivisionWeak.3: Count the group out loud — note {{position}} of {{outOf}} is where it slips.

drift.1: You started with the click and drifted {{amount}} {{when}} by the end.
drift.2: It pulls {{when}} as you go: {{amount}} adrift by the last bars.
drift.3: The tempo under your hands slides {{when}} across the segment.

tempoCeiling.1: {{hold}} holds together. At {{collapse}} it comes apart.
tempoCeiling.2: Your ceiling here is {{hold}} — {{collapse}} isn't yours yet.
tempoCeiling.3: You own {{hold}}. {{collapse}} is the next thing to earn, not today's tempo.

improved.1: That's better — {{bars}} is {{ms}} ms steadier than last time.
improved.2: Something moved: you held {{bars}} where it used to slip.
improved.3: Real progress in {{bars}} — tighter by {{ms}} ms than your earlier goes.

clean.1: Nothing to fix in {{bars}} — right on all {{goes}}.
clean.3: You played {{bars}} right every time. Leave it and come back to it.

stage.keepPortionNote: Choose bars on the tab first, then give them a name

offer.failed: Yames could not open that file. It may still be downloading.

songs.keepsCopy: Yames keeps its own copy of every file you bring in, so clearing your downloads loses nothing.
songs.exportFailed: Yames could not write the file there.

findTab.note: Opens your own browser on an ordinary web search. Yames looks nothing up for you.

camera.denied: The camera was not allowed. Let Yames use it in your system settings, then turn this on again.
camera.guideBody: Get both hands in the frame — the one on the neck and the one over the strings.
camera.introPrivate: Nothing is uploaded and nothing is sent anywhere. Deleting a take deletes its picture with it.
camera.introWhat: The camera records you playing, from the count-in until you stop. The sound is the take — your playing with the band, as it already is.
camera.introWhere: It is written as one video file beside the take, in this app's own folder on this machine, and it stays there until you delete it.
camera.label: Camera
camera.lead: your hands, kept beside the notes — nothing leaves this machine
camera.lostPicture: The camera stopped part way through. The take was kept; the picture was not.
camera.noCamera: There is no camera on this machine.
camera.noOffset: Nothing measured where the picture sits against the sound on this take, so it starts level. Nudge it until your hands land with the notes.
camera.nudgeHow: If your hands look ahead of or behind the sound, nudge the picture until they land together. It is remembered for this camera.
camera.pitchDropped: At slower speeds the pitch drops with the tempo here.
camera.pitchKept: The pitch stays where it is at slower speeds.
camera.preview: You, as the camera sees you
camera.unavailable: This version cannot record a picture. Everything else on this screen works as it always did.

clip.realTime: It records as it plays, so it takes as long as the music: {{length}}.
clip.isMp4: You get an MP4, which posts anywhere.
clip.isWebm: You get a WebM. Some places only take MP4.
clip.failed: That video could not be made. Nothing was saved.
clip.unavailable: This version cannot save a video.
